description: CI-repair style: a local pipeline script (custom AST lint, unittest run, build check that validates __all__ exports) fails in three consecutive stages because it stops at the first red stage - lint (unused import, debug print, long line), tests (inclusive tier boundary and billable weight using min instead of max) and build (stale __all__ entry after a rename). The agent has to fix the code, not the pipeline, so ci.py and the tests are protected. The post-turn verifier runs the pipeline for a repair round.
